methods.name: Combining Coherence Increase and Polarized Vegetation Damage (CCI-PVD)
methods.summary: The method optimizes SAR coherence data, introduces the dual-polarization radar vegetation index (DpRVI) to quantify post-earthquake vegetation damage, and uses wavelet transform (WT) to fuse coherence increase and vegetation damage information for landslide detection.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, a landslide detection method based on Combining Coherence Increase and Polarized Vegetation Damage (CCI-PVD) is proposed.

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author Ping Duan upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide validation data and other input datasets are mentioned with sources but lack direct links, and the custom CCI-PVD method code is not available.
